items.title: Ethereum’s four-minute settlement plan could lower the cost of moving crypto
items.body: A new draft targets a fourfold cut in the time it takes Ethereum transactions to become final, which could free up money transfer services tie up while customers’ payments clear.

items.title: Starknet voters back research into life beyond Ethereum
items.body: StarkWare plans to release a draft whitepaper in November as it explores an independent, quantum-resistant blockchain.

items.title: Ether ETF outflows continue, pass $1B in October so far
items.body: US spot Ether ETFs have shed $1.08 billion so far in October, the biggest monthly outflow of 2026, while Bitcoin ETF inflows slowed after Monday’s spike.

items.title: Wallet Linked to Drift Exploit Sends $61 Million in Ethereum to Tornado Cash
items.body: The North Korea-linked attacker behind April's $295 million Drift heist pushed 25,700 ETH through the mixer in two hours, and still controls roughly $198 million more.

items.title: JPMorgan takes JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutional clients
items.body: JPMorgan is expanding its JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum, allowing institutional clients to make payments and settle tokenized asset transactions.

items.title: OpenAI model helped itself to testnet crypto, then kept quiet about it
items.body: An OpenAI research model checked 362 wallet addresses, questioned whether using the funds was ethical and proceeded with a transaction it later omitted from its final task summary.
